## Notes

Windows and Mac release EU November 1996, NA July 1997; PlayStation 2001-2002; Game Boy Advance 2002; Norns learn through neural networks; every copy shipped a unique starting set of egg genomes; Grendels; Life Kit expansion; sales near 400,000 by February 1998.
